title: Double Tender Burger Combo for Two: 2 Burgers, 2 Regular Chips & 2 Regular Drinks $11.95 @ KFC (Pick Up Only)
body:
Deal: Double Tender Burger Combo for Two: 2 Burgers, 2 Regular Chips & 2 Regular Drinks $11.95 @ KFC (Pick Up Only)

[itsfree] Great deal. Unfortunately targeted (and, more unfortunately, I was not)
[justtoreply] I refuse to support tenders as a viable burger filling. It's shrinkflation gone mad.
[justtoreply] How is your comment relevant to what I wrote? You're asking me to support shrinkflation.. I said I don't. I'd rather pay more than be part of a race to the bottom
[shxhshzhz] If you don't think it's a viable burger filling, feel free to share a comparable deal with a viable filling to help OzBargainers get a better deal instead of just calling it shrinkflation. Double tender burgers have been sold for years. No one is asking you to support shrinkflation 😂.
[onyx981] @shxhshzhz: This deal is usually for regular crispy/zinger burgers. I'm assuming they're testing the waters swapping the 2 to see if will people buy it anyway so they can save some money. Also I agree with the other guy, this is a weird response, lol. It's less depressing to buy some cooked tenders from woolies along with some chips and shove them in a bun instead the salty tiny leather tenders from kfc, there's your better deal. You'll probably have tenders left over for later too.
[justtoreply] @shxhshzhz: Do you usually struggle when people have an opinion? Not bothering to respond further. Thanks for the post
[grasstown] Yes I havnt yet tried it despite all the offers.
[Agret] The one along bell st (KFC Preston) is right on the corner of a busy intersection, really annoying to get into it
[adam24] Shrinkflation with a double serving of carbs. Society gone mad
[teatea] I got the 2 zinger burgers, 2 reg chips, 2 drink, 10 nuggies on my app for 16.95. YMMV
[Agret] Damn that's a way better feed for $5 more
[jimbler] Got a crappy crispy burger and go bucket whatever that is for $8.95
[worldpc] I stop getting these targeted promo for a few months now, hope it gets fix
[toneypaloney] Not sure about other states but in WA kfc raised pretty much every items price.
